sanitization: No tool Match, Secret, author, email, message or link fields. Digests are included only after source/archive verification. Paths, commit IDs, line/column ranges, Git object IDs, SHA-256 values and classifications are retained.
method: Read each candidate only from its exact historical Git evidence blob and reported line. Reconstruct the redacted scanner match and require it to occur on that exact line. Require a unique JSON leaf holding a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 and prove it equals the Git blob at the source commit explicitly named by that evidence. All source commits read must be reachable from the scanned HEAD. The vendor original-file record also requires the matching cached crate archive member and recorded archive/revision identifiers. A same-evidence-commit hash is only a secondary check. No code from history is run.
